author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Eagle head in profile facing right: domed crown from the rear feather spike, hooked upper beak with its back edge, a throat curve down to the chin spike, jagged neck feathers along the bottom and left, and a fierce brow with the eye hung from it. Naturally asymmetric. No Lucide match; line + cubic construction.
omissions: The gape line running into the face and the eye's half-ring are reduced to the beak edge and an eye dot joined to the brow (8-unit spacing).
